subject.title: feat(ui): add message preview to session list

question: Should maintainers ask for this branch to be reworked against the current Sessions page, sponsor a replacement PR, or defer the preview feature to broader Sessions UX work?
rationale: The backend contract exists and the feature remains useful, but this external PR is stale, conflicting, proof-missing, and tied to a canonical issue that already carries maintainer/product-decision labels.

options.title: Request a current-page rework
options.body: Ask the contributor to update this PR onto ui/src/pages/sessions/*, use lastMessagePreview instead of subject, remove the scratch doc, and add redacted browser proof.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement PR
options.body: If the branch is not worth preserving, a maintainer can keep the canonical issue open and replace this PR with a narrow current-main implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader Sessions UX
options.body: If maintainers do not want an incremental list preview, leave the canonical issue open for the larger Sessions design path and pause this PR.

recommendation.title: Request a current-page rework
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to update this PR onto ui/src/pages/sessions/*, use lastMessagePreview instead of subject, remove the scratch doc, and add redacted browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and merged PR metadata point to vincentkoc as the strongest owner for the active Sessions page and UI type surface.
